name: agentfactory
description: Workspace for building and testing pi agents.

scripts.pi: bash -c 'set -a && source models.env && set +a && cd pi-sandbox && exec pi --no-context-files --provider openrouter "$@"' --
scripts.mesh: bash -c 'set -a && source models.env && set +a && cd pi-sandbox && exec pi --recipe "$1" --provider openrouter --is-host' --
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/deferred-rails/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/containment-rails/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui-rails/tsconfig.json
